_note: Curated nightly price tiers for a chalé/pousada sleeping two, by town. These exist because Airbnb's robots.txt disallows /s/*/* — the search path — so MATE cannot legally discover live prices. Lodging candidates themselves are real, named places from OpenStreetMap; only the price is a tier. Every figure derived from this file renders with a ~ and the plan says it is a typical rate, not a quote. If the user pastes an actual listing, airbnb_listing_details fetches the real price (that path IS allowed) and it replaces the tier.
basis: per night, two people, chalé or pousada with kitchen
